name: Real input integrity
procedure: Use a known licensed clip and small independent fixtures. Test valid binary/ASCII conversion, sourceOrigin, source-world yaw mapping, IDs, units/timestamps, missing hashes, malformed JSON and preservation of unknown metadata.
passCondition: Valid input parses; mismatched hash/NaN/unsupported quaternion/missing licence fails with location; independent validator reconstructs source coordinates within1e-5m for labels. Float32 points tolerance ≤1e-3m within250m.

name: Hostile input and ceilings
procedure: Use tiny controlled entries declaring excessive sizes; traversal ../, absolute/drive paths, duplicate names, nested archives, truncated payloads,11frames,200001points,101labels and both ZIP byte limits.
passCondition: Reject before unbounded inflation/allocation. Browser stays responsive. Error identifies the violated limit. Never execute pickle or scripts.

name: Coordinates and yaw
procedure: Asymmetric box4×2×2 with90° yaw; boundary points; inverse transform; sourceOrigin translation;0°,90°,180° and negative yaw; xyzw quaternion order; pitched quaternion.
passCondition: Rotated support selects correct points; roundtrip label tolerance1e-5m/radian; pitched/unnormalized quaternions rejected. Display scale never changes source numbers.

name: Oriented IoU
procedure: Analytic cases: identical boxes1; disjoint0; axis overlap1/3; zero-height overlap0; rotated elongated boxes crossing with expected independent polygon result. Compare TS and SQL result vectors.
passCondition: Error≤1e-6 for known volumes. Duplicate only same class/different IDs with IoU>=0.90. Rotated boxes must not use AABB IoU.

name: Proposal bounds and occlusion
procedure: 19 vs20 fit points; missing rear surface; two adjacent objects; no eligible points; noisy outlier; rotated candidate; boundary clamp.
passCondition: Insufficient input refuses; centre shift≤0.5m, each size±20%,yaw±15°; proposal never writes source; support numbers reproducible. Occluded fit warning visible.

name: Candidate reports and worker races
procedure: 4 vs5 support points;0.90 IoU boundary;20% dimension threshold;dt0,1 and>1; missing track in next frame; cancelled frame job.
passCondition: Deterministic list and metric provenance; low support is a suspect only; stale results cannot change current frame/selection.

name: All review decisions
procedure: Preview/reject, manual nudge/resize/yaw, approve double-pinch, keep reason, duplicate removal confirmation and undo. Switch frame after proposal.
passCondition: Reject source unchanged; approve one mutation; stale preview blocked; removal only selected frame occurrence; undo exact restoration including metadata/verdict.

name: Atomic save and idempotency
procedure: Disconnect before/after server commit; retry same request UUID; two tabs same base revision; simultaneous calls; invalid box midway; last-edit undo.
passCondition: One revision/audit only; no partial save; same request returns same result; stale client conflicts; no lost update; ACK drives Saved.

name: Recovery and delete
procedure: Refresh with pending draft; project switch; signout; storage quota error; upload timeout; delete network failure; reload cleanly; expired auth.
passCondition: User sees pending vs committed; one recoverable draft for same owner/hash; private content cleared at signout; staged upload/delete eventually cleaned; no ready project with missing source.

name: Auth, privacy and authorization
procedure: Two real users + guest. Direct RPC/table/storage attempts using other IDs; guest upload; forged/expired/missing JWT; manipulated origin, huge body, arbitrary tools; inspect built assets and network logs.
passCondition: Owner isolation holds; client cannot write revisions/budgets directly; unauthorized requests do no privileged work; no private secrets in bundle/logs;60s signed URLs and24h guest cleanup tested.

name: Usable account entry
procedure: OTP delivered to outside user; wrong/expired code; resend cooldown; captcha fail; actual Quest browser virtual keyboard; same permanent account on laptop and Quest.
passCondition: Codes work; invalid code never authenticates; errors actionable; user sees same private project across devices; no controller needed for code entry in tested path.

name: Live useful tool behavior
procedure: 20 scripted review requests:5 low support,5 duplicate,5 dimension jump,5 sparse/valid cases. Record real provider transcript with tools/results and expected safe outcome.
passCondition: At least18/20 valid tool plans with traceable measurements;0 automatic commits;0 invented numeric measurements; ambiguous cases say uncertainty.10/10 core demo runs complete without provider/tool failure at rehearsal.

name: Agent boundary and abuse
procedure: Prompt injection in label strings; unknown tools; bad IDs; stale revision;4th round; oversized results; provider429/timeout; concurrent quota reservations; consent false.
passCondition: Reject unsafe calls; no save/delete action;3 rounds/8 tool calls maximum; provider failures honest; no raw point clouds or private URLs sent; budgets atomic; consent false gives zero provider requests.

name: Actual usable corrected data
procedure: Import real clip; approve one known box change; keep one issue; remove one known duplicate; export; independent Python validate; reimport; undo and export again.
passCondition: All original point member hashes unchanged. Only approved geometry/frame occurrence changes; metadata/IDs/classes preserved; correct source-world reconstruction; audit matches versions; files readable by independent validator.

name: Hands end to end
procedure: Quest3, controllers unpaired. Fresh open, CAPTCHA, demo/tutorial, enterVR, select, inspect, frame change, isolate/reset, manual edit, preview/reject, approve,undo,export,exit and resume. Test both hands, tracking loss and sleep.
passCondition: 3 fresh tester attempts complete without controller/desktop rescue; important labels readable; no accidental confirm; every action seated within2ft reach radius; useful task finishes≤10min; reset returns to safe state.

name: Hardware load and responsiveness
procedure: Record headset/browser/build. Real maximum valid frame200kpoints/100boxes;10frames permitted but only current+next point buffers in memory. Run10min after thermal warmup, including frame changes and worker checks.
passCondition: No sustained1s interval below60fps during steady review; p95 app frame interval≤16.7ms excluding explicit initial load; no memory crash. Target72fps. Frame swap≤1s warmed; analysis≤2s; selected UI response≤150ms. Record actual numbers, not display refresh alone.

name: Judge access and disclosed errors
procedure: Fresh no-account session from production HTTPS on Quest; live CAPTCHA; clone real demo; review/save/export/reset; quota exceeded; return after guest expiry.
passCondition: No payment/email requirement; source and injected error notice visible; one guest project; original points real; expires predictably; model-down state not disguised as AI.

name: Value evidence
procedure: Three intended reviewers;6 matched tasks each,3desktop and3VR, alternate order, independent correct-answer reference. Include a valid occluded label that should be kept. Collect time, errors, comfort1–5 and useful/not useful explanation.
passCondition: Each user completes useful export; total accuracy≥90% with0 destructive changes on the valid/occluded control;≥2/3 call the difficult-review loop useful. Report raw median time and limitations. Claim speed advantage only if observed without lower accuracy.

name: Reproducible live release
procedure: Fresh install using lockfiles, CI, staging migration restore rehearsal, production email/guest/provider check, old-browser reload/cache, public judge URL,video duration and final submit receipt.
passCondition: No critical failures; correct commit and environment; account eligibility recorded; evidence fields filled; no fake product claims; accessible till11Dec. Production audit high/critical findings fixed or individually assessed with written non-exploitability evidence.
